findings.title: `float: right` on the button is ignored now that `.small-action` is a flex container
findings.body: `.small-action` became `display: flex`, and `float` has no effect on flex items. The `button { float: right; }` rule (and `.topic-avatar { float: left }`) therefore no longer does anything. The button, which was pushed to the right edge before, will now sit directly after the description text. The rule needs `margin-left: auto` or an equivalent, or the dead float declarations should be removed.

findings.title: Hard-coded percentage padding replaces the fixed 4em indent
findings.body: `padding: 0.5em 0 0.5em 4em` became `padding: 0 1.5%`. The description's left offset now depends on container width instead of lining up with the 45px icon column. The description is also no longer given `flex: 1` or a similar sizing rule. Long text or a custom message can therefore push the button or squeeze the avatar, and the alignment will vary across viewports. The removed vertical padding and margins also change the spacing of every small-action post, which the PR title doesn't mention.

findings.title: `align-items` mixin passes the modern value to legacy prefixed properties unchanged
findings.body: The same `$alignment` is written to `-webkit-box-align` and `-ms-flex-align`. Those legacy syntaxes use different keywords: `start`/`end` instead of `flex-start`/`flex-end`. `-ms-align-items` is not a real property at all. The mixin only works for `center` and `baseline`. Any other value will produce invalid declarations in older browsers. The line on 120 also has trailing whitespace.

findings.title: `.extra-info-wrapper` styling changes may regress bullet badge alignment
findings.body: The `&.bullet { margin-top: 5px }` compensation is removed and `line-height: 1.5` is added to the wrapper. The bullet badge's vertical position inside the topic header now depends on the flex centering and the new line-height, with no explicit handling. Floated `.badge-wrapper` children inside a flex item are also a fragile combination. Nothing in the PR shows that this was visually verified.

findings.title: PR title and description do not match the change
findings.body: The description is just "Test 5". The change goes beyond header layout: it also reworks `.small-action` post styling, the badges, and the topic title styles. Reviewers cannot tell the intended scope, or why `float` was replaced by flexbox for performance.
